title: Juicy Tangy Canadian Pork Grill
description: A tangy and juicy Canadian-inspired pork dish perfect for brunch. This recipe features a sweet and smoky robata-grill flavor.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together apple cider vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the pork shoulder with olive oil and season with thyme and rosemary.
Sear the pork shoulder on the robata-grill for 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a baking sheet.
Add the sliced onions to the robata-grill and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the potatoes to the robata-grill and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until they are tender.
While the potatoes are cooking, brush the pork shoulder with the apple cider vinegar mixture and return to the robata-grill for an additional 2 minutes per side.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving with the roasted potatoes and onions.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
